subject: Discovery follow-up: quick fit check + pilot invitation
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acmelogistics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: quick fit check + pilot invitation

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for taking time last Thursday to walk through Acme's use case for customer support automation. Quick recap from our side so we're aligned: 

• Current pain: rising agent velocity costs and inconsistent KB retrieval at scale (32% wrong article rate in peak windows).
• What we showed: Redwood inference routing + prefix caching reduced token cost in our demo and produced more consistent KB retrieval across long contexts.
• Desired outcome you mentioned: reduce triage time by ~20% and cut per-conversation inference spend while preserving answer quality.

Two quick asks from me: 
1) Any signal on fit from your side — is this something you want to pilot in the next 60 days?
2) If yes, we can set up a 2-week pilot (small cluster, dedicated support + integrations help). I attached a short evaluation template and a one-page pilot proposal with rough SOW and pricing.

Proposed next steps (pick one):
- 15-min sync this week to map success criteria and sample data (I can do Thu 11–11:30 PT or Fri 9–9:30 PT).
- If procurement needs to review, I can loop in our contracts lead and send a concise pilot SOW for sign-off.

Attachment: redwood-eval-template.xlsx (simple checklist)
Attachment: pilot-proposal.pdf (one-page SOW + price range)

If you're not the right owner, could you point me to who owns the pilot decision?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acmelogistics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Logistics Procurement <procurement@acmelogistics.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: quick fit check + pilot invitation

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the summary and the materials. Quick note from procurement: we need SOC 2 evidence and a clearer pricing line for any pilot before legal will sign off. From the product team side, we liked what we saw in the demo but our timeline has shifted a bit — headcount reprioritization means this might slip into late May.

I CC'd procurement to start the vendor intake. Procurement, could you review the attached pilot proposal and let Naomi know what additional info you need?

Thanks,
Tom

Hi Tom / procurement team —

Wanted to bump this thread briefly to see if you had any feedback on fit or open asks from procurement. If useful, we can: 

• Start a no-risk 30‑day evaluation with a small reserved cluster (Redwood covers first week of infra for proof-of-concept) so your product team can validate throughput and quality without a long commitment.
• Provide SOC 2 summary and a short vendor pack (I included the link to our Trust page below).
• Put together a clean pilot SOW and a single-line price for procurement to review (example: pilot up to 50 concurrent threads for $X/month).

If you're open, I'm happy to book a 15-min call to align and remove blockers. My availability: Thu 10:00–10:30 PT or Fri 08:30–09:00 PT. If those don't work, tell me a couple of times that do and I'll adapt.

Trust page: https://redwood.ai/trust (SOC 2 summary and vendor pack)
Doc link: https://redwood-docs.s3.amazonaws.com/pilot-proposal-ACME-2327.pdf

Thanks for checking in — looking forward to your signal.

Best,
